style_basis: Native weapon HUD sprites and actual unmodified-art HUD captures; left-facing, natural aspect, pale ivory silhouettes with contour detail and negative spaces. Offline texture exports showed artifacts and were not used as visual approval evidence.
native_art: 341 entries resolve original native game addresses. These remain stand-in weapon shapes, not exact Chinese artwork. MALVA is absent from the native bundle, so PLA uses 2A64_MSTA.
